resources.string: Share your connection to use another node. Up to 3 devices can connect to you.
Sharing is capped at one third of your measured upload speed. These are traffic statistics, not a credit balance.
Discover nearby nodes or add a trusted invitation. Start sharing before connecting.

Upload is measured automatically when sharing starts, the network changes and every 15 minutes, or manually here. Each cycle sends up to 24 MiB total of HTTPS test data to Selectel, with 59telecom as fallback. No peer is needed. Measurement disconnects the VPN; reconnect afterwards.

The public catalog spreads through known participants. Reachable nodes connect directly; devices behind CGNAT can use a reachable participant relay. A first known live participant is required. Without a reachable address or participant relay, connection is not guaranteed. Local discovery works on the same network. There is no central server.

Invitations contain confidential access tokens; share only with people you trust. Other devices use your public connection while sharing. Selectel and, if needed, 59telecom receive your IP during speed tests. User traffic is not sent to these diagnostic services.
Country is approximate. The app automatically sends your public IP to api.country.is for country lookup. Automatic speed tests also contact Selectel or fallback provider 59telecom.

Only selected apps use the VPN; all others connect directly. Choose at least one app. Only launchable apps with internet access are listed; PeerNet is excluded. Saving disconnects an active or connecting VPN. Reconnect to apply the selection.
Choose at least one installed app in Settings before connecting. An empty selection cannot start a VPN.

App selection saved. Reconnect to use the VPN.

Opt in to share your signed address and approximate country with participants and relay through participants. A first known live participant is required. Direct access needs public IPv4/IPv6 or port forwarding; mobile data plus Wi-Fi alone do not help if both devices are unreachable. There is no central server.
